Come on now, think about this....

Organic foods, grown in soil fortified with manure (and other organic sources) is full of microbial life that we have evolved with since eternity. Most of the nutrition you absorb from the food you eat (and a plant absorbs from its roots) is completed with the aid of this microbial life. In one teaspoon of healthy soil, there is 10,000 to 50,000 species of organisms. In that same teaspoon of soil, there are more microbes than there are people on the earth. These are the micro-machines of life. Your health depends on them.

Because the industrial fertilizers are absorbed directly by the plants with no need for further molecular breakdown, the plants grow fast and visually produce well. Unfortunately they are missing many minerals and vitamins, prone to pests and diseases and doused with pesticides that disrupt our endocrine systems . Industrialized farming interferes with microbial life on many fonts.

My comment 'you literally are what you eat' was referring to the fact that your body replenishes all the cells within your body over time. On average ~8 years, with some cells living for days while others for years. These replacements are generated from your food so every cell in your body was once a molecule of food.
